name: Ethan Juan
bio: Ethan Juan (Chinese: 阮經天; born November 11, 1982) is a Taiwanese actor and model. He is known for his roles in Monga (2010), The Assassin (2015), and television series Fated to Love You (2008).

It’s also a quest of love and work, a spiritual and emotional journey; and through which values are re-examined and life reaffirmed.
